newsitem.title: USA: IBM passes all-time high, then slips.
newsitem.headline: IBM passes all-time high, then slips.

text.p: Shares of International Business Machines Corp continued their climb after Goldman Sachs initiated coverage of the computer giant, briefly surpassing their highest levels in history.
IBM hit a new all-time high in intra-day trading of 176-1/8, surpassing its historical high of 175-7/8, but then fell back to 175, up 3-1/8, in very active trade.

Goldman Sachs analyst Laura Conigliaro initiated coverage of IBM and added the stock to both Goldman's recommended list and its priority list, fueling even more investor enthusiasm in the stock, traders said.
